    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">100行Python代码，搭一个能干活的AI Agent</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">跟大模型聊天人人都会，但你有没有想过——为什么ChatGPT能帮你订餐、查航班、写代码，而你调用API只会一问一答？</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>差别就两个字：</span><strong><span>Agent</span></strong><span>。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">大模型是大脑，但没手没脚没记忆。你问它"北京天气怎么样"，它只会说"我无法访问实时数据"。Agent就是给大脑装上四肢、记忆和执行力——让它自己判断该用什么工具，执行完再思考下一步。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">听起来很复杂？其实核心就一个公式：</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>Agent =&nbsp;</span></strong><strong><span>LLM</span></strong><strong><span>（大脑）+ Tools（双手）+ Memory（记忆）+ Loop（循环）</span></strong></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">今天用100行Python代码，把这四个模块从零搭一遍。不依赖任何框架，跑完你就明白Agent到底是怎么回事。</span></p><section><span><br></span></section><section><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px"><section style="text-align: center"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span style="font-size: 15px">00 环境准备</span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0"><span><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section><h2><span><br></span></h2><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code>pip install openai</code></pre><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>用OpenAI SDK，兼容DeepSeek、智谱等国产API，改个</span><code><span>base_url</span></code><span>就行。这篇用DeepSeek做demo——便宜，而且支持按量付费。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">你需要去https://platform.deepseek.com/注册拿一个API Key。</span></p><section><span><br></span></section><section><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px"><section style="text-align: center"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span style="font-size: 15px">01 LLM调用 —— 给Agent装个大脑</span><span><br></span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0"><span><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 0.48) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 0.48) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 0.48) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 0.48) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 0.48) 100%); -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section><h2><span><br></span></h2><p><span style="font-size: 15px">第一块拼图：能跟大模型对话。</span></p><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code>from openai import OpenAI
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os

load_dotenv()

client = OpenAI(
    # api_key="your-api-key", # 换成你的DeepSeek API Key
    api_key=os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"), # 或使用env方式存储apikey
    base_url="https://api.deepseek.com"
)

def ask_llm(messages, tools=None):
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="deepseek-v4-flash",
        messages=messages,
        tools=tools,
        tool_choice="auto",
    )
    return response.choices[0].message

res = ask_llm([{"role":"user","content":"你好"}])

print(res)</code></pre></section><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>这段代码本身没什么特别的，就是标准的API调用。但注意</span><code><span>tools</span></code><span>这个参数——这是Agent和普通聊天的核心分界线。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>不传</span><code><span>tools</span></code><span>，模型只能聊天。传了</span><code><span>tools</span></code><span>，模型就知道"我还有这些工具可以用"，在需要的时候会主动要求调用。</span><code><span>tool_choice="auto"</span></code><span>的意思是让模型自己判断：这个问题我直接答，还是得用工具？</span></span></p><blockquote style="white-space: pre-wrap"><section style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>⚠️ 踩坑提示 DeepSeek的deepseek-chat模型已废弃，对应deepseek-v4-flash模型中的非思考模式</span><code><span><br></span></code></span></section></blockquote><section><span><br></span></section><section><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px"><section style="text-align: center"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span style="font-size: 15px">02 工具定义 —— 给Agent装双手</span><span><br></span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0"><span><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 0.48) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 0.48) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 0.48) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 0.48) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 0.48) 100%); -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section><h2><span><br></span></h2><p><span style="font-size: 15px">工具就是普通的Python函数，外加一份给LLM看的"说明书"。</span></p><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code>def calculator(expression: str) -&gt; str:
    try:
        return str(eval(expression))
    except:
        return "计算错误"

def get_weather(city: str) -&gt; str:
    mock = {"北京": "晴 25℃", "上海": "多云 28℃", "深圳": "雷阵雨 30℃"}
    return mock.get(city, f"暂无{city}天气数据")

TOOLS = [
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "calculator",
        "description": "执行数学计算，输入数学表达式",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "expression": {"type": "string", "description": "数学表达式，如 2+3*4"}
        }, "required": ["expression"]}
    }},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "查询指定城市的天气",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "city": {"type": "string", "description": "城市名称"}
        }, "required": ["city"]}
    }}
]

TOOL_MAP = {"calculator": calculator, "get_weather": get_weather}</code></pre></section><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>这里有个关键认知：</span><strong><span>LLM</span></strong><strong><span>不直接执行代码</span></strong><span>。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>它只做一件事——输出一段JSON，告诉你"我想调用calculator工具，参数是</span><code><span>123 * 456 + 789</span></code><span>"。真正执行计算的是你的代码。LLM的角色更像一个调度员，决定调用什么工具、传什么参数，但脏活累活都是你的程序干。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><code><span>description</span></code><span>字段很重要，写得越清晰，模型调用越准确。模型是靠读这个描述来理解工具用途的——你说"执行数学计算"，它就知道算术题该找这个工具。</span></span></p><section><span><br></span></section><section><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px"><section style="text-align: center"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span style="font-size: 15px">03 记忆 —— 让Agent记住上下文</span><span><br></span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0"><span><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 0.48) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 0.48) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 0.48) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 0.48) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 0.48) 100%); -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section><section><span><br></span></section><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code>class Memory:
    def __init__(self):
        self.messages = []

    def add(self, role, content, **kwargs):
        msg = {"role": role, "content": content}
        msg.update(kwargs)
        self.messages.append(msg)

    def get_messages(self):
        return self.messages.copy()</code></pre></section><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">就这？就这么简单。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>很多人觉得Agent的"记忆"很高深，其实本质就是维护一个</span><code><span>messages</span></code><span>列表。每次调用LLM时，把完整的对话历史传过去——LLM本身没有状态，所谓的"记住上下文"就是每轮都把历史消息全部塞进请求里。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">这也解释了为什么聊天越长，API费用越高——因为每次请求都带着之前所有的对话。</span></p><section><span><br></span></section><section><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px"><section style="text-align: center"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span style="font-size: 15px">04 Agent循环 —— 让Agent会思考</span><span><br></span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0"><span><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 0.48) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 0.48) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 0.48) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 0.48) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 0.48) 100%); -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section><h2><span><br></span></h2><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>这是整个Agent的心脏。核心思路叫</span><strong><span>ReAct</span></strong><strong><span>模式</span></strong><span>：思考→行动→观察→重复，直到任务完成。</span></span></p><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code>def run_agent(user_input, max_steps=10):
    memory = Memory()
    memory.add("system", "你是一个有用的助手，可以调用工具回答问题。")
    memory.add("user", user_input)

    for step in range(max_steps):
        print(f"\n--- 第{step + 1}步 ---")
        response = ask_llm(memory.get_messages(), tools=TOOLS)

        if not response.tool_calls:
            print(f"Agent回答：{response.content}")
            return response.content

        memory.add("assistant", response.content or "", tool_calls=response.tool_calls)

        for tool_call in response.tool_calls:
            name = tool_call.function.name
            args = json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments)
            print(f"调用工具：{name}({args})")
            result = TOOL_MAP[name](**args)
            print(f"工具返回：{result}")
            memory.add("tool", result, tool_call_id=tool_call.id)

    return "达到最大步数，Agent停止"</code></pre></section><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">拆解这个循环：</span></p><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1"><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>思考</span></strong><span>：把对话历史和工具列表发给LLM，LLM决定下一步干什么</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>判断</span></strong><span>：如果LLM没有请求调用工具，说明它觉得可以直接回答了，循环结束</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>行动</span></strong><span>：LLM说"我要查北京天气"，你的代码就执行</span><code><span>get_weather("北京")</span></code></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>观察</span></strong><span>：把工具执行结果塞回messages，让LLM看到结果</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>重复</span></strong><span>：LLM拿到结果后再思考，可能还需要调别的工具，也可能可以直接回答了</span></span></p></li></ol><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><code><span>max_steps</span></code><span>是安全阀，防止Agent陷入死循环。实际使用中10步足够处理大部分任务。</span></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">跑起来看效果</span></h2><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code># 测试1：简单计算
run_agent("帮我算一下 123 * 456 + 789")</code></pre></section><p><span style="font-size: 15px">输出：</span></p><section style="text-align: center" nodeleaf=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1279674/202608/1279674-20260813224124046-697612576.png" alt=""></section><p><span style="font-size: 15px">两步完成：第一步调计算器，第二步直接回答。</span></p><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code># 测试2：多步骤任务
run_agent("北京和上海哪个温度高？并帮我算一下高多少？")</code></pre></section><p><span style="font-size: 15px">输出：</span></p><section style="text-align: center" nodeleaf=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1279674/202608/1279674-20260813224124557-2092965632.png" alt=""></section><section><span><br></span></section><section><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px"><section style="text-align: center"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span style="font-size: 15px">Silas说</span><span><br></span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0"><span><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 0.48) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 0.48) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 0.48) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 0.48) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 0.48) 100%); -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section><h2><span><br></span></h2><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>写完这100行代码，最大的感受是：</span><strong><span>Agent一点都不神秘</span></strong><span>。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">网上铺天盖地的Agent框架——LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI——把这件事包装得很复杂。但你把核心扒开看，就是一个while循环：LLM决定调什么工具，你的代码执行，结果传回去，循环直到完成。框架做的事，无非是帮你把这个循环封装好，再加上一些工程化的东西（重试、超时、日志）。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>我的建议：</span><strong><span>先手写一遍，再用框架</span></strong><span>。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><span>不是框架不好，是你不理解原理直接用框架，出了问题完全不知道怎么排查。你不知道</span><code><span>tool_calls</span></code><span>的格式长什么样，不知道messages里每条消息的role有什么讲究，调试的时候就是两眼一抹黑。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">还有一点：别急着给Agent加复杂的Planning和Multi-Agent协作。先把这个最小闭环跑通，加一个你自己业务场景需要的工具（比如查数据库、调内部API），让它真正干一件有用的事。能稳定跑一周，再考虑扩展。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">Agent的价值不在于架构多精巧，在于它能不能稳定地把一件事干好。</span></p><hr style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-right: 0 solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-bottom: 0 solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-left: 0 solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5)"><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">跑通代码后，可以试试这些扩展方向：</span></p><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1"><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>换个工具</span></strong><span>：把</span><code><span>get_weather</span></code><span>换成查数据库、调内部API、发邮件——只要是个Python函数就能当工具</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>加RAG</span></strong><span>：给Agent接一个知识库，让它能查文档回答问题</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>多Agent协作</span></strong><span>：多个Agent分工合作，比如一个负责搜索、一个负责写作</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span>试试框架</span></strong><span>：理解原理后再用LangChain或CrewAI，你会发现它们其实就是帮你封装了这套循环</span></span></p></li></ol><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">完整代码我已经整理好了，复制就能跑。你给Agent加了什么有意思的工具？评论区聊聊。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">觉得有用的话，转给也在折腾AI的朋友。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 15px">关注我，持续分享AI实操和踩坑记录。</span></p><section><span></span></section><h2><span style="font-size: 15px"><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">&lt;完整代码&gt;</span></span></h2><section><span><br></span></section><section><pre style="background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7"><code>"""
最小AI Agent实现 —— 100行代码搞定
Agent = LLM + Tools + Memory + Loop
"""
from openai import OpenAI
import json
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os

load_dotenv()

# ============ 1. LLM调用（大脑）============
client = OpenAI(
    # api_key="your-api-key", # 换成你的DeepSeek API Key
    api_key=os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"), # 或使用env方式存储apikey
    base_url="https://api.deepseek.com"
)

def ask_llm(messages, tools=None):
    response = client.chat.completions.create(
        model="deepseek-v4-flash",
        messages=messages,
        tools=tools,
        tool_choice="auto",
    )
    return response.choices[0].message

# ============ 2. 工具定义（双手）============
def calculator(expression: str) -&gt; str:
    try:
        return str(eval(expression))
    except:
        return "计算错误"

def get_weather(city: str) -&gt; str:
    mock = {"北京": "晴 25℃", "上海": "多云 28℃", "深圳": "雷阵雨 30℃"}
    return mock.get(city, f"暂无{city}天气数据")

TOOLS = [
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "calculator",
        "description": "执行数学计算，输入数学表达式",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "expression": {"type": "string", "description": "数学表达式，如 2+3*4"}
        }, "required": ["expression"]}
    }},
    {"type": "function", "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "查询指定城市的天气",
        "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {
            "city": {"type": "string", "description": "城市名称"}
        }, "required": ["city"]}
    }}
]

TOOL_MAP = {"calculator": calculator, "get_weather": get_weather}

# ============ 3. 记忆（对话历史）============
class Memory:
    def __init__(self):
        self.messages = []

    def add(self, role, content, **kwargs):
        msg = {"role": role, "content": content}
        msg.update(kwargs)
        self.messages.append(msg)

    def get_messages(self):
        return self.messages.copy()

# ============ 4. Agent循环（心脏）============
def run_agent(user_input, max_steps=10):
    memory = Memory()
    memory.add("system", "你是一个有用的助手，可以调用工具回答问题。")
    memory.add("user", user_input)

    for step in range(max_steps):
        print(f"\n--- 第{step + 1}步 ---")
        response = ask_llm(memory.get_messages(), tools=TOOLS)

        if not response.tool_calls:
            print(f"Agent回答：{response.content}")
            return response.content

        memory.add("assistant", response.content or "", tool_calls=response.tool_calls)

        for tool_call in response.tool_calls:
            name = tool_call.function.name
            args = json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments)
            print(f"调用工具：{name}({args})")
            result = TOOL_MAP[name](**args)
            print(f"工具返回：{result}")
            memory.add("tool", result, tool_call_id=tool_call.id)

    return "达到最大步数，Agent停止"

# ============ 5. 测试 ============
if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_agent("北京和上海哪个温度高？并帮我算一下高多少？")</code></pre></section><section><span><br></span></section><section><section><section style="display: flex; flex-direction: column"><section style="align-self: center"><section style="display: flex"><section style="width: 53px; height: 1px; align-self: center; background: linear-gradient(270deg, rgba(172, 33, 34, 1) 0, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.63) 100%)"><span><br></span></section><section style="text-align: center; padding: 0 10px"><p style="font-size: 16px; font-family: PingFang SC; font-weight: bold; line-height: 22px; color: rgba(172, 33, 34, 1)"><span style="font-size: 15px">THE END</span><span><br></span></p></section><section style="width: 53px; height: 1px; align-self: center; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(172, 33, 34, 1) 0, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.63) 100%)"><span><br></span></section></section></section></section></section></section><section><span><br></span></section><section><section><section style="border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; padding: 5px"><section style="border-style: dashed; border-width: 1px; padding: 15px"><section style="text-align: center" nodeleaf=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1279674/202608/1279674-20260813224125235-2007790884.gif" alt=""></section><p cid="n6" mdtype="paragraph" style="box-sizing: border-box"><span md-inline="link" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 15px"><span md-inline="plain" style="box-sizing: border-box"><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" target="_blank" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA3NTAwNTI3MA==&amp;mid=2247484422&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=c296698a18f155a3b50b9d6603e93359&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" textvalue="RAG知识库搭建大揭秘：原来这么简单，还能这么有趣！" linktype="text" rel="noopener nofollow">RAG知识库搭建大揭秘：原来这么简单，还能这么有趣！</a></span></span></span></p><p cid="n7" mdtype="paragraph" style="box-sizing: border-box"><span md-inline="link" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 13px"><span md-inline="plain" style="box-sizing: border-box"><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 13px" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA3NTAwNTI3MA==&amp;mid=2247484346&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=5ad427fbb915e0dc44cf1cb22db0c038&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" textvalue="" linktype="text" rel="noopener nofollow">简明教程：实现OpenCLaw轻量级应用服务器部署及Ollama大模型本地化</a></span></span></span></p><p cid="n10" mdtype="paragraph" style="box-sizing: border-box"><span md-inline="link" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 15px"><span md-inline="plain" style="box-sizing: border-box"><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" target="_blank" style="box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 13px" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA3NTAwNTI3MA==&amp;mid=2247484306&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=e80f98bf36d37788c32ac505949867aa&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" textvalue="" linktype="text" rel="noopener nofollow">Dify+Ollama模型搭建攻略：本地环境实战指南</a></span></span></span><span><br></span></p></section></section></section></section><p style="display: none"></p>
